title: Adverse Action Notice Record
description: A record of the specific, individualised reason given to a consumer for an adverse credit or lending decision an automated system contributed to.
evidence_description: A per-applicant record of the specific reasons given for an adverse credit or lending decision, including the underlying contributing factors identified by the underwriting model, retained for later review if a dispute arises.
collection_method: Generated automatically at decision time by the underwriting system, alongside the notice sent to the consumer.
retention_period: Minimum 25 months, aligned with typical US adverse-action record-keeping requirements.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of per-applicant reasons and contributing factors.
